description: We are making the space mission game
summary:
GALAXY MISSIONS is a 3D space exploration game where players become astronauts and complete four exciting space missions.
The game includes:
Asteroid Dodge: Avoid asteroids and survive for 60 seconds.
Moon Landing: Safely land your spacecraft on the landing pad.
Galaxy Explorer: Explore the solar system and learn interesting space facts.
Space Collector: Collect crystals while avoiding dangerous mines.
Key Features:
Three selectable spacecraft: Falcon, Nova and Titan.
Three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard.
3D graphics and animated space environments.
Background space music and sound controls.
Achievements and trophy system.
Keyboard and mobile touch controls.
details:
GALAXY MISSIONS is an interactive 3D space exploration game designed to make learning about space more exciting and entertaining. It allows players to experience four different missions: Asteroid Dodge, Moon Landing, Galaxy Explorer and Space Collector. Players can choose their spacecraft, select difficulty levels, complete challenges, collect rewards and unlock achievements.

The main aim of this project is to combine education with entertainment. It encourages students to explore space, develop curiosity about the universe, and improve their concentration and problem-solving skills through interactive gameplay.

We developed this project using HTML for the structure, CSS for styling and animations, JavaScript for game logic and Three.js for 3D graphics. We also used the Web Audio API to create background music and sound effects.

The creative aspect of our project is that it combines multiple space-themed games into a single platform with 3D spacecraft, animated environments, alien encounters, customizable music and different difficulty levels.

During development, we focused on creating a user-friendly interface, attractive design, smooth gameplay, mobile and desktop compatibility, and an engaging experience for players. Our overall vision is to make space exploration more interactive, accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
